checks: Aggregate fetch buffer budget across brokers and partitions (ConsumerConfig::buffer_memory, default 32 MiB, builder .buffer_memory() / .fetch_buffer_bytes()).
Slow processing and max_poll_records cannot grow unbounded memory across partitions and brokers; pending queue tracked in buffered_bytes and fetching stops when saturated.
Preserve progress for a valid first batch larger than the soft fetch limit, with the existing 64 MiB hard decode ceiling from KL02-03.
Decompression bombs exceeding 64 MiB hard ceiling are rejected with 'Decompressed batch exceeds maximum allowable size'.
Pause retains buffered records in pending queue and accounts for them in buffered_bytes without committing undelivered data.
Resume allows draining of held records on subsequent poll.
Seek drops buffered records for the target partition and releases buffered_bytes immediately via drop_pending_for.
Dropping or clearing assignment releases all buffered records and resets buffered_bytes to 0.
Zero buffer_memory disables aggregate cap for backward compatibility.
No undelivered records committed on auto-commit or manual commit; delivered position reflects next consumable offset.

limits: Process RSS is not bounded by buffer_memory or buffered_bytes; process memory includes allocator fragmentation, Tokio worker tasks, TLS context buffers, TCP frame buffers, and client metadata.
No unsafe code and no new dependencies added.
